blocks.text: BANGA, South Cotabato — Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand Hernandez called for faster congressional action on proposed restrictions on children’s social media use following the deadly shooting at Banga National High School. Hernandez, who represents South Cotabato’s second district, said the Sept. 18 incident highlighted concerns over young people’s exposure to potentially harmful online content. “There should be no need for another life to be lost. Unfortunately, it happened yesterday,” Hernandez said in an interview Saturday.
